businessContact.verification: music@resurgeaudio.com is first-party published on the official site, syntactically valid, domain-aligned and explicitly designated for music submissions. info@resurgeaudio.com and copyright@resurgeaudio.com are first-party general and copyright contacts and were not substituted for the canonical form. businessContact.verification: The official Global Entry Radio page does not publish a direct submission or business email; it provides an official contact form for syndication/partnership questions and exclusively links submissions to Groover. support@groover.co is a publicly documented Groover platform-support address, not a music-submission mailbox. No email address was inferred, decoded or substituted, and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

activityVerification.evidence: The official site lists Global Entry Radio episode 100 dated July 3, 2026, episodes 97-99 from April-June 2026, a current 40+ outlet/15+ country syndication network and the active Groover submission call.

formBoundary.paymentModel: Grooviz credits; Groover currently documents €1 per Grooviz and normally 2 Grooviz per curator, while the exact price for this curator must be confirmed in-session.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: The open music-submission-agent pull request and repository search contained no existing canonical match for Resurge Audio, Joshua Tree Live or Global Entry Radio by official name, domain, submission path, published contact or Groover influencer identifier before creation.
deduplication.consolidation: Resurge Audio's form and official music mailbox were consolidated into one record. Joshua Tree Live's form and general media contacts were consolidated without treating the inconsistent .io address as verified. Global Entry Radio's official page and exact Groover route were consolidated as one external-platform opportunity.

notes: Three legitimate opportunities were queued as needs_manual_review.
